messages:
liam: quick RFC follow-up on the 'soft-token + signed-hint' approach for admission/proxy coordination. want to capture attack vectors we missed and a conservative rollout plan.
anya: thanks — high level acceptance from security, but we flagged two things: clock skew signed-hints and cross-proxy hint-farming.
brooks: on clock skew: any HMAC-based hint must include an issuer_ts and ttl, and admission should accept a small skew window (e.g., +/-2s) but drop wildly future/expired hints. also include issuer_id so we can blacklist misbehaving proxies.
liam: agreed. proposal: signed hint payload = tenant, concurrency_hint, expire_ts, nonce, issuer_id; HMAC over canonicalized payload. admission will only trust hints signed by registered proxies.
sara: how do we prevent a tenant bouncing between proxies to collect better hints? e.g., one proxy sees low load and issues generous hints, tenant routes there.
brooks: two mitigations: 1) hints are short-lived (200-500ms) and carry a stability_score from admission, 2) proxies must apply a cooldown when switching sources and attach prior_hints_digest to new requests for reconciliation.
devsec: prior_hints_digest sounds helpful but can be spoofed. ensure digest includes the proxy's signing key id and a monotonic sequence or nonce chain. also log when proxies change hint sources too often and raise risk.
anya: also we should avoid any hint that can be used to inflate quotas. make clear that hints can only cause local shaping decisions; final counting must be by admission (authoritative). proxies can optimistically allow a small soft-burst but must not increment global counters.
liam: that's our plan: admission authoritative counters; proxies only emit telemetry events that are labelled proxied_relay=true. admission will reconcile telemetry by matching request_nonce within a reconciliation_window (default 10s). if telemetry exists without authoritative counter, admission treats as soft and does not double-charge.
brooks: edge-case: what if a proxy is partitioned and issues many nonces that never arrive to admission until after the reconciliation window? we risk undercounting.
sara: remediation: proxies should persist nonce logs locally and attempt exponential backoff replays on reconnect, tagged as late_replay. admission will process late_replay but mark them in a separate metric stream and apply asymmetric penalties to risk score rather than decrementing quotas retroactively.
liam: can we sketch the hint endpoint shape?

```
GET /admission/v1/hint?tenant_id=org-123
200 OK
{ "concurrency_hint": 8, "stability": 0.9, "ttl_ms": 300, "issuer_id": "proxy-10", "sig": "hmac..." }
```

devsec: include a hint_version field so we can roll forward format changes without breaking older proxies. and the sig must cover version.
anya: instrumentation checklist: hint_issued, hint_used, hint_switched, hint_stability, proxy_hint_source_switch_count, late_replay_count, reconciliation_skips. ops team needs dashboards and alerting thresholds.
brooks: tests: 1) churn test: tenant hops across 5 proxies within 1s — verify risk score increases and admission degrades hints. 2) partition test: proxy loses connectivity for 12s then reconnects and replays nonces — verify late_replay metrics and non-double-charge behavior. 3) clock skew test with +/-5s drift.
liam: rollout plan: feature-flag signed-hints v1 behind admission.feature.soft_hints; rollout steps: canary 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> global over 48h windows. at each step monitor p99 latency, hint_stability, and late_replay_count.
sara: add a kill-switch to revert proxies to using local soft-metering if admission shows >1% mismatch between telemetry and counters.
ops-bot: deploy: admission-service v4.2.0 (soft-hints feature flag) promoted to staging at 2026-04-02T09:41:12Z :rocket:

liam: action items: brooks to spec hint signing format and key rotation; anya/devsec to write threat model and tests; sara to add dashboards; brooks/sara to author chaos tests; liam will open PR for admission reconciliation logic with local benchmark numbers. will attach a short rollout playbook in PR.
anya: thanks all. let's sync again after the PR lands. :raised_hands:
